propositions: Routine MCP backoff conditions (port-exhausted retire-cap and low-memory abort) emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR markers that incorrectly increment deploy_errors counter and false-page the rebar-autodeploy-errors alarm.
The observability.sh contract explicitly documents that retire-cap and mem-abort tokens must be kept out of AUTODEPLOY_ERROR to avoid inflating deploy_errors on routine operations.
record_mcp_backoff_failure unconditionally calls err deploy_failed for both routine backoff paths and genuine failure paths, violating the documented contract.
Genuine MCP deploy failures (build-failed, tag-failed, run-failed, unhealthy, handshake, flip) must continue to emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR and page rebar-autodeploy-errors without regression.
The backoff throttle mechanism (MCP_BACKOFF_FILE write and prune) must remain active on all paths including routine backoffs to prevent tick hammering during graceful drain.
